MEADOWRUN ORCHARDS — OUTBOUND SHIPMENT MANIFEST
Shipment reference: SH-2841. Product lot: AP-73.
Consignee: Larkspur Grocers Cooperative. Container: CH-06.
48 crates of dessert apples were loaded, six pallets in total; gross cargo mass: 1,152 kg.
Loading completed on 2026-08-19 at 05:40 CEST.

SEAL CONTROL
Container seal CH06-991 was intact at dispatch. The carrier received the signed manifest at 05:48 CEST.
The manifest records no driver name, fuel quantity or customer purchase-order number.

COLD-CHAIN LOGGER EXPORT — SH-2841 / CH-06
Required transport range: 2–6 °C.
Mean product-zone temperature: 4.4 °C; highest recorded reading: 6.3 °C.
Readings remained above 6 °C for 12 minutes, from 09:16 to 09:28 CEST.
The logger export reports no power-loss interval. No calibration-certificate expiry date is included.

LARKSPUR GROCERS — DIJON DEPOT RECEIPT
Shipment SH-2841 reached the Dijon depot on 2026-08-19 at 14:20 CEST.
The driver used the east approach after the D19 north exit was closed for roadworks.
All 48 crates were counted at intake; the container seal was intact. No damaged-crate count was entered.

RECEIVING DESK NOTE
The receiver confirmed the pallet count but did not identify the driver. The dispatch record contains no fuel-consumption reading.
The depot note does not state whether the brief logger excursion affected fruit quality.

ATELIER DES VALLONS — CERTIFICAT D’ANALYSE
Lot AP-73, pommes dessert. Échantillon prélevé le 18 août 2026.
Solides solubles : 12,4 °Brix.
Acidité titrable : 0,42 g/100 mL.
Rapport approuvé le 20 août 2026 par le laboratoire.

PORTÉE DE L’ANALYSE
Le certificat porte uniquement sur les paramètres indiqués ci-dessus. Aucun dosage de résidus de pesticides n’a été effectué.
Le nom d’un acheteur final et le numéro de commande ne figurent pas sur le certificat.

CONSIGNE D’EMBALLAGE — EXPORT
Pour chaque caisse de pommes, placer deux sachets réfrigérants dans les emplacements latéraux prévus.
Garder l’étiquette du lot AP-73 visible après fermeture.
À la réception, inspecter l’emballage dans les 36 heures et noter tout sceau rompu.

NOTE DE CONTRÔLE
Cette consigne décrit l’emballage et la réception. Elle ne fixe pas la date de la prochaine expédition et ne vaut pas rapport de qualité du fruit.

BOREAL WASH-LINE WATER — LABORATORY CERTIFICATE
Sample point: Well B-4. Sample date: 2026-08-20.
Laboratory pH reading: 7.2.
Nitrate concentration: 18 mg/L.
Laboratory disposition: acceptable for the wash line. The certificate was filed by the Water Quality Unit.

RECORD SCOPE
The certificate identifies the unit, not an individual sampler. It contains no repeat-sample result or signed reconciliation with field readings.

BOREAL WASH-LINE — FIELD SHEET
Well B-4, sample taken 2026-08-20. Field pH reading: 7.6.
Field nitrate reading: 21 mg/L. Provisional disposition: HOLD FOR DUPLICATE TEST.
The sheet and laboratory certificate are both current records. Their different readings and dispositions have not been reconciled or superseded.

MEADOWRUN PACKLINE — QUALITY AUDIT SUMMARY
Audit completed on 2026-08-28. Recorded score: 96/100.
The audit reviewed crate handling, seal checks and cold-room records.
It did not record a pesticide result, driver safety rating or the next planned delivery date.
